newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dollar at 175.60/65.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends firmer vs dollar at 175.60/65.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended firmer against the dollar but remained steady against the central bank's currency basket as the dollar/mark dictated play on Budapest's interbank forex market on Thursday.
The forint closed right on the central bank bid at 175.60/65 to one dollar, compared with 175.88/93 at midday.
"It was all about the dollar/mark today," said Noemi Koppendorfer of Magyar Hitel Bank. "There was no strong selling or buying interest otherwise."
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
